name: CONFIRM_RESET_NUDGE
expected: [system] NOTHING has been reset — the conversation is intact and this call is carrying on as before. Starting fresh wipes everything discussed so far and cannot be undone, so it needs the user to actually say they want that. Do NOT tell them anything was cleared or that you're starting over. Ask in ONE short line whether they want the whole conversation wiped, or just to drop the last thing — "want me to clear the whole conversation, or just drop that?" is the shape. If they confirm the wipe, call resetSession again and it will go through. If they only meant the last thing ("forget it", "never mind", "drop that" usually do), don't call it again: drop that subject and carry on. If they meant work — something running, or something waiting — that is interrupt or cancelQueued, not this.
